title: Qualify the candidate and establish the 1.0 freeze
goal: Demonstrate a stable API/SPI/schema in real consumers and make the complete release gate and post-1.0 compatibility policy blocking in CI.
context: Architecture phase D. Approximate size: M. The candidate closes the one pre-1.0 transition. This phase introduces qualification and compatibility enforcement, without reopening the architecture. Physical extraction is conditional future work and does not block the 1.0 milestone.

consumes: The consolidated implementation and regression evidence from the preceding phase
produces: Candidate/final supported-surface and non-PHP compatibility baselines
Blocking archive-consumer and release qualification checks
Complete upgrade guide and recorded race/load evidence
boundaries: 1.0 requires every release condition on the candidate commit
A tag must not bypass the candidate qualification matrix
Future code movement retains logical FQCNs, schema/history and durable data

include: API generator and tests/Arch ownership/member rules
Existing driver/cache/replica, race, load and consumer suites
Configuration/event/audit/CLI/error format fixtures and upgrade documentation
exclude: Commercial edition branches or alternative schemas

pitfalls: Regenerating a manifest on the same branch does not prove compatibility
continue-on-error consumer checks do not qualify a distribution
Release validation on a tag must cover the qualified candidate
Interface additions, named parameters, defaults and closed enum additions can break implementers

validation.procedure: Verify all ten release conditions in knowledge/architecture#release-gate on the candidate commit, including supported platform/driver/cache/replica checks, archive consumers, recorded race/performance results and all PHP/non-PHP baselines; verify stable-tag comparison and tag gating fail on an intentional breaking fixture.
validation.expect: Every release condition is green with reproducible evidence; archive failures and incompatible stable-tag changes are blocking.

deliverables: Frozen API/SPI, schema and machine-format baselines
Permanent ownership, activation, parity and compatibility checks

sections.title: Exit criterion
sections.text: The entire documented 1.0 release gate is satisfied. A release decision has concrete evidence, and no required architecture boundary or compatibility format remains undecided.
